item.title: Bulletin updated at 05:50 HKT 30/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring fine weather to southern China persistently today. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Nalgae is expected to move across the central part of the South China Sea today. It will then take a more northerly track. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent movement and intensity. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach southern China early this week. Under the combined effect of Nalgae and the northeast monsoon, it will be windy over the coastal areas early to midweek this week.
